feed.title: enterpriseai.tools weekly updates — agent-identity
feed.subtitle: High-impact market intelligence for enterprise AI tooling, with an expandable release log for lower-signal product changes.

entry.title: Token Vault Cross-App Access supports SAML in early access
entry.summary: On November 20, 2026 Auth0 extended Token Vault's Cross-App Access to users who sign in through SAML enterprise connections, in early access. The IdP must exchange SAML assertions and issue ID-JAGs.

entry.title: Entra Agent ID previews local agents; lifecycle management is GA
entry.summary: Microsoft said on November 17, 2026 that Entra Agent ID for discovered local agents is in preview and automated lifecycle management of agent identities is generally available. An out-of-the-box policy disables agent identities inactive for 60 days.

source.title: AI is changing access: see how Entra helps you stay ahead

entry.title: Okta for AI Agents works with third-party identity providers
entry.summary: Okta said on November 13, 2026 that third-party IdP support is generally available for Okta for AI Agents and Agent SSO, built on Cross App Access and needing no custom connector.

entry.title: Agent Identity auth manager adds 3-legged OAuth for A2A agents
entry.summary: Google said on November 13, 2026 that 3-legged OAuth with the Agent Identity auth manager is generally available, so A2A agents built with ADK on Agent Runtime can call MCP servers, Google Cloud and third-party APIs for the signed-in user.

entry.title: Auth0 launches Auth for UCP in Early Access
entry.summary: Auth0 Auth for UCP, in Early Access, secures Universal Commerce Protocol servers by linking a shopper's agent identity to their account with a business.

entry.title: Auth0 lets MCP clients connect without pre-registration
entry.summary: Auth0 added Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD) with Dynamic Registration in Early Access, so MCP clients and AI agents can connect without being registered in advance.

entry.title: Descope Agentic Identity Hub 3.0 adds governance suite
entry.summary: Agentic Identity Hub 3.0 adds an Agentic Governance Suite (Enterprise tier), policy engine v2 with explicit deny policies, Agent SSO via Cross-App Access (ID-JAG), and SPIFFE, private_key_jwt and mTLS client authentication.

entry.title: SailPoint Agent Identity Security — feature
entry.summary: At Navigate 2026 SailPoint announced autonomous identity security agents, AI identity security posture management, an agent kill switch, runtime authorization, shadow-AI discovery and just-in-time provisioning for agents.

entry.title: Okta for AI Agents — feature
entry.summary: Okta made Agent SSO generally available, built on the Cross App Access standard and included in core Okta SSO.

source.title: Okta brings first-class identity to AI agents with Agent SSO · Okta

entry.title: Saviynt Zuma — release
entry.summary: Saviynt launched Zuma, an AI identity security platform with agent discovery, runtime intent-aware access, and governance for AI agents and non-human identities.
